name: eval-pyramid-starter
description: Provider-neutral TypeScript starter for layered LLM and agent evaluations.

scripts.test:pyramid: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:system
scripts.eval:deterministic: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli.ts run --sut example --trials 1 --k 1 --judge none
scripts.eval:repeat: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli.ts run --sut example --trials 5 --k 3 --judge none
scripts.eval:live: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli.ts run --sut http --trials 5 --k 3 --judge openai --fail-on-gate
scripts.eval:ci: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli.ts run --sut example --trials 3 --k 3 --judge none --fail-on-gate
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.eval:regression: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli.ts run --sut example --trials 4 --k 3 --judge none --tool-fault transient-refund-every=4 --regression swallow-refund-errors
scripts.eval:fault: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx src/cli.ts run --sut example --trials 4 --k 3 --judge none --tool-fault transient-refund-every=4
